title: Figures 18-19: BHD apparatus schematic and predicted Casimir spectral density
description: Figure 18 is an optical schematic with signal S and LO beams passing through PBS1, a half-wave plate (HWP) and PBS2 to photodiodes PDx and PDy, with an inset showing the optic axis, captioned "Detailed Schematic of Experimental BHD Apparatus. (courtesy of P. Marecki)." Figure 19 is a color heatmap of distance from the bottom plate x (µm) versus Frequency, captioned "Predicted Casimir Spectral Density σyy," with negative values (suppressed fluctuations) shown in deep purple.
